Taynton Bowl has recent snowfall over a well packed wintery base. Lesser tracked lines remain and some deeper powder pockets in the trees and some gullies. A refreshed feel from recent wind load, riding really well overall. Fresh tracks yesterday morning in many areas, including Heli High to Starfire and Donnie B's. Monster X hauls today.

Nordic groom has a good, packed base for great conditions overall. Cooler, clear weather overnight should see decent set up on the fresh groom. Multi-use trails are on for fat biking with melt/freeze cycles in warmer PM weather - firm and slick early, and softer later in the day. Check the website or in person for more information and to purchase passes.
